notes: The final paired eight-key matrix was scored after joint hash validation; the score receipts and complete coverage are recorded below.
The final coordinated panel is 16 records across four styles; this supersedes the review note's 32-record starting suggestion before row selection and is recorded as a pre-run scope choice.
No unpublished TRR-0003 output was opened. Shared public model, dataset, and published diagnostic assets remain read-only.

Verified public preparation now exists: panel selection, two opaque 16x40x2048 BF16 observation arms, full 128256-entry BF16 table, and a post-BOS identity diagnostic. These records do not constitute final comparative accuracy.

The post-BOS diagnostic froze predictions and receipt-bound plan/qualification bytes before loading labels; cosine and L2 both achieved 256/256 identity with zero ties and collisions, without private truth or CUDA.
The earlier arm-000 static prediction freeze passed the CPU-only freeze validator and is retained as provisional integration evidence outside the final paired matrix.
Evaluator preparation ran before its source was committed; the manifest records the missing run-time source identity and the next-commit mapping explicitly rather than claiming commit certification.
Windows Git explicit task-ref dry-run passed without pushing; any publication must reverify the task ref and never use common-repository HEAD.

The largest representative 8-record K256 method cell passed CPU resource qualification under commit 9fb635a7f66866da05a08cb6084da7b1704f13a3; it remains resource/comparator evidence only and does not supply panel truth accuracy.

Fresh final evaluator preparation under evaluator-final-20260905 froze both opaque public arms with all eight declared prediction keys at commit 6e05fee; both committed-source reconstruction runs at e43a595 subsequently froze and scored all eight outputs after joint validation.

A bounded CPU reservation attempt for final arm-000 under commit 6e05fee exited 124 before producing predictions; exact phase is unknown because the pre-logging runner emitted no phase telemetry. It is excluded, arm-001 was not launched, no memory anomaly was reported, and no batching or matrix change was made. The raw progress/log records remain unchanged; the 8-record qualification estimate did not predict the full 16-record by 40-slot phase.

Final arm-000 reconstruction completed on CPU at e43a595 with all eight prediction keys frozen before truth. Static, correction, historical-port, phase, I/O, and shared process RSS values are recorded in cost_accounting.final_arm_000; the historical A1 timing is reused by the port and is not additive.
Both final opaque arms completed all eight declared prediction keys under e43a595 and passed the joint 28-file hash validation before truth opening; score receipts were created only after that gate.
The final score matrix is exploratory: 16 records, 39 post-BOS positions, 624 scored tokens per arm, with exact position and four-style breakdowns retained in quality_matrix and the two score files.

The redacted post-score development-exclusion mapping is published as task-local metadata with source row IDs, styles, text hashes, public artifact hashes, score hashes, and the arm-to-condition join; source plaintext, private truth, target weights, and raw evaluator-private records remain local.
Publication is pending root commit, push, and PR. Global coordination state and the active method registry remain unchanged.

Independent final-results audit passed join, coverage, and freeze-order checks. It found reference correction correct at position 1 for all records but only 3/16 matched and 4/16 shifted at position 2, so neither current static/correction variant merits another unchanged round.
